create_uniform_distribution: create a UniformDistribution to uniformly sample integer IDs for a replay buffer
build_transition_replay: build a TransitionReplay buffer with fixed capacity for uniform sampling of transitions
build_prioritized_replay: build a PrioritizedTransitionReplay buffer that samples transitions proportional to their priority
create_nstep_accumulator: create an NStepTransitionAccumulator to accumulate timesteps into n-step transitions for DQN
compress_numpy_array: compress a numpy array with snappy and uncompress it back using compress_array and uncompress_array
